main_text.l: clivis, inde acclivis anni; solstitium in-
tuus Eliezer. Etenim si Tecupha demum
tionis; si, inqvam dies 19 Tebeth inci-dens in
rietis nondum egresso) ut ne momento
tis ritum fuisse legitimum Luculentus est
iste locus Eliezeris, atqve auro supra mi-
hi carus, qvi tantum jam temporis hoc
nem tuam istam ut edas rogo, aut si edi-
tus est, ubinam, & qvanti præstat, indi-ces.
Hic si frustra sum, alterum meum erit

page.notes: The Hebrew word after "ut" (הקופת) is only roughly legible at this scan resolution; marked [?]. The Greek catchword is right-aligned below the last line and is given only in bottom_margin. Italic "ces." and the heavier "Hic si frustra sum" line are set in a different type and may be emphasised rather than italic; kept as printed.
